(define (make-account balance)
  (define (withdraw amount)
    (if (>= balance amount)
        (begin (set! balance (- balance amount)) balance)
        "insufficient funds"))
  (define (deposit amount)
    (set! balance (+ balance amount))
    balance)
  (lambda (message)
    (cond ((eq? message 'withdraw) withdraw)
          ((eq? message 'deposit) deposit)
          ((eq? message 'balance) balance)
          (else (error "unknown request" message)))))

(define acc (make-account 100))

((acc 'deposit) 50)          ; 150
((acc 'withdraw) 30)         ; 120
(acc 'balance)               ; 120
description: make-account returns a dispatcher that selects withdraw, deposit, or balance operations based on a message symbol, encapsulating state in a closure.
